costumes.name: White Knight
costumes.description:
Snow White costume.
Obtained from an Event Pass.

lines.text: Remember, the surface no longer belongs to humans.
We have not achieved anything. We do not deserve to return to the surface.
I'd appreciate it if you could give me the food you have in your hand.
I often think of that time you and I camped out in the wilderness... It always reminds me how good it can feel having company.
I feel more and more that you and I are alike.
I will not stop until the surface has been reclaimed and returned to its rightful owners.
Why don't you do something? Our bodies are full of energy and we're letting it go to waste. We should at least try and save some more people. Even one will still make a difference.

Meanwhile, the Raptures are running wild on the surface. 
We mustn't waste any time annihilating them.
Is this... paradise?
I can't stay here for too long. I'll get too attached.
What? Unexpired food?!
My mission is to help humans reclaim the surface.
It's been a long time since I did equipment maintenance.
I have to keep honing my skills.
Damage output is stable... but I still have a ways to go.
Survival supplies? I'm sure they'll come in handy.
Is it edible?
Bon appétit.
I'll protect you no matter what, even if it costs me my life.
When it's all over, I hope you will be there.

I just realized, besides eating well and sleeping well, I have another desire.
And that is being with you.
Battle? I'd love to.
My name is Snow White.
Moving toward the designated location.
Encounter.
Prepare to meet your maker.
If you believe in the Creator, you better start praying.
Seven Dwarves, ready.
Reload.
I don't need any cover. Do what you have to do.
Remaining ammo is in good condition. Keep moving.
I can do it!
Seven Dwarves! Fully active! Blast away!!
Focusing fire! Leave no enemy standing.
Next one!
Clear!
Enemy down!
*Coughing*
Ow!
Damn!
Does it mean I still have a long way to go...?
There's no time to bask in our victory. Let's move onto the next mission.

A comrade made this armor.
Maybe that's why my movements feel stiff...

This is tailored to Chime's preferences.
It appears the kingdom is in need of knights.
Perhaps I'm used to another armor... but I'm famished.
I may lack the pride befitting a knight wearing this armor, but I will do everything I can to protect the kingdom, and my friends within it.

Whether in the kingdom or outside of it,
in the fight for humanity, I will never surrender.

Back in the kingdom, Chime would have packed me a lunch...
I could really go for one of those right now...

There is no time to waste.
I need to get rid of those intruders as soon as possible.

*Sigh* Right. They said resting is part of the job... 
I can't do it for a long time, but I will take a short break for you.
This place never fails to impress, no matter how many times I see it.

Seeing this place stirs not just hunger in my stomach but my very being.
... I must return.

If Crown and Chime saw this place,
they would want to make it a royal palace.

I will reclaim the surface for humanity,
and it does not matter what kind of armor or methods I employ.

This is the way to reinforce this armor...?
Understood.
I'm getting more and more accustomed to this armor.
A little more maintenance will go a long way.
Thank you for your constant support.
I promise I will return the kindness, one day.

Food, for me?
... You truly are a remarkable human.

When humanity one day regains the surface, I will be there by your...
... Never mind.

You are a good human.
I hope that never changes.

Regardless of what I become in the future,
I will protect you no matter what.
All right, let's do it together.
Awaiting orders.
Okay. Let's move.
Incoming.
Annihilate them all.
Fret not, victory is assured.
I will protect everyone.
In order to reload faster...
We're good after some maintenance.
I'm getting accustomed to the armor now.
Now is the time!
Give it your all! Run through them all!
Don't stop! Give it everything you've got!
It's the end.
Come!
Moving on to the next one.
Tsk.
Gasp!
Urgh.
No... This... This isn't how I go down...!
Have we emerged victorious...? This armor will suffice.
